description: This file defines utility objects for handling activity result contracts related to file and media operations in an Android app, such as choosing files, storage location, exporting/restoring notes, and taking pictures.

classes.name: ChooseFilesContract
classes.description: Handles intent creation and result parsing for selecting multiple media files.

classes.name: StorageLocationContract
classes.description: Handles intent creation and result parsing for selecting a storage location.

classes.name: ExportNotesContract
classes.description: Handles intent creation and result parsing for exporting notes as a zip file.

classes.name: RestoreNotesContract
classes.description: Handles intent creation and result parsing for restoring notes from a zip file.

classes.name: TakePictureContract
classes.description: Handles intent creation and result parsing for capturing a photo.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent for the specific activity result contract.

methods.name: parseResult
methods.description: Parses the activity result intent to extract the relevant data.
